title_sq: Vilë - Për Shitje - Liqeni i Farkës, Tiranë (ID: 530361015-234)
description_sq:
Smart Hills eshte nje nder projektet me te reja ne zone i cili pozicionohet ne perendim te liqenit te Farkes.
Kjo zone eshte e njohur per vlerat e saj rezidenciale te cilat shprehen ne aspektin klimaterik dhe ambiental.
Vlen te permendet pamja panoramike qe ofrohet ne drejtim te Jug-Perendimit.
Zona eshte e pasur me burime ujore ne formen e liqeneve , baseneve ujore dhe perrenjve.Bimesia ne kete zone eshte e pasur me lloje te tipit shkurre dhe pemetari mesatare.Vlen te permendim Liqenin e Farkes i cili eshte nje atraksion qe ndodhet rreth 200 m nga vendodhja e prones.
Ne aspektin e sherbimeve tregtare, prona ka nje distance prej 3.7 km, nga Qendra tregtare TEG.
Lidhja kryesore me qendren e qytetit te Tiranes, realizohet nepermjet Unazes Lindore dhe rruges Panorama e Liqenit.
Rrjeti rrugor eshte i brendshem duke lehtesuar aksesin ne cdo banese . Per krijimin e nje parku rekreativ eshte menduar pjesa qe ndodhet ne qender te zones duke bere te mundur qasjen e barabarte persa i perket
distancave nga te gjithe banoret.
Vila A
240 m2 te ndara ne 2 kate x 120 m2 dhe
Oborr 200 m2 dhe vende parkimi.
Cmimi i afishuar vlen per pagesen me keste. Per pagesen e plote ka hapsire per diskutim.
Investimi pritet te kete nje kthim prej 70% ne vit.
Tregu ne zonen e Liqenit te Farkes eshte rreth 2500-2800 Euro m2 dhe pritet te shkoje nga 3500-4000 m2 duke qene se ska me toka te lira dhe oferta ne raport me kerkesen jane ne rritje te kerkeses dhe mbarimit te ofertes.
Qeraja ne kete zone eshte 3500 E/muaj me te ardhura vjetore rreth 45.000 euro vit.
Projekti pritet qe te mbaroje ne me pak se 30 muaj ne te gjithe komponentet e vet.
title_en: Villa - For Sale - Farka Lake, Tirana (ID: 530361015-234)
description_en: Smart Hills is one of the newest projects in the area, which is positioned in the west of the Farka lake. This area is known for its residential values, which are expressed in terms of climate and environment. It is worth mentioning the panoramic view offered in the South-West direction. The area is rich in water resources in the form of lakes, water basins and streams. The vegetation in this area is rich in types of bushes and medium trees. It is worth mentioning the Farka Lake, which is an attraction located about 200 m from the location of the property. In terms of commercial services, the property has a distance of 3.7 km from the TEG shopping center. The main connection with the center of the city of Tirana is realized through the Eastern ring road and Panorama e Liqeni street. The road network is internal, facilitating access to every apartment. For the creation of a recreational park, the part located in the center of the area is considered, making possible equal access in terms of distances from all residents. Villa A 240 m2 divided into 2 floors x 120 m2 and yard 200 m2 and parking spaces. The posted price is valid for cash payment. For the full payment there is room for discussion. The investment is expected to have a return of 70% per year. The market in the area of ​​Lake Farka is around 2500-2800 Euro m2 and it is expected to go from 3500-4000 m2, since there are no free lands and the offer in relation to the demand is increasing as the demand and the end of the offer. The rent in this area is 3500 E/month with an annual income of around 45,000 euros per year. The project is expected to be completed in less than 30 months in all its components.
